Night. Kitchen work islands have hard downward neutral fixtures with controlled pools of light. Upper observation gallery is dim, lit by weak blue night spill. START STATE AND BLOCKING
The upper gallery overlooks the KITCHEN itself. Camera behind the observers looks downward. Armayil left, Garmayil right. A small preparation-room doorway is visible at the kitchen rear right. Guard A and B bring the Night B pair toward that doorway. Two masked kitchen workers remain at separate workstations.

SHOT 02A | 00s to 06s | 6 seconds
18mm high-angle view through the gallery aperture. A slow 15cm handheld lean reveals sinks, preparation surfaces and cookware, making the kitchen unmistakable. Guards take the two captives through the rear-right doorway; its door closes. Keep the observers as partial back silhouettes at the edges.
SHOT 02B | 06s to 09s | 3 seconds
50mm from the same upper opening, tighter on that closed doorway. Explicit time ellipsis: later, Guard A emerges carrying one tray with exactly two closed containers. Guard B closes the door behind him; the captives remain unseen. Ordinary kitchen labor continues in the edge of frame.
SHOT 02C | 09s to 13s | 4 seconds
40mm side two-shot on the upper gallery: Armayil left facing right, Garmayil right facing left. Garmayil holds Armayil’s gaze. Armayil takes one breath, then gives one small deliberate nod. Garmayil briefly clasps his forearm; their masks stay inanimate.
SHOT 02D | 13s to 15s | 2 seconds
28mm wider on the gallery. They release hands and separate: Armayil exits screen right along the passage leading toward kitchen access; Garmayil exits screen left toward the service stores. Both leave on foot with controlled urgency.
END STATE AND EDIT
They have silently agreed to intervene. Cut forward in time to their work-clothing state; the actual costume change is omitted.
SOUND
Distant water and metal utensils, door weight, closed containers vibrating on a tray, a breath and one forearm fabric touch.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
